about: Code-path cases added 2026-10-20 before any gated run (eval-gate build checks (a) and (b)). They make every code check in evals/eval_config.yaml reach its minimum of 5 cases from the visible set alone, and add two interaction cases from evals/INTERACTION_SWEEP.md. No case here is routed by the AI: each expected route follows from the workflow's own code (Validate lead, Find earlier lead, test flags). Send after tests/leads.json and tests/leads-set2.json (C05 needs X01 first, C13 needs S2F01). All people and companies are fictional; e-mails use example.com subdomains; no website is given, so no mock page is needed.
